name: implement
description: Purpose agent implement tinh nang Viezan end-to-end tu PRD/issue den code, i18n, tests, docs va security gate.

classification.use_for: Use when the user asks to implement a feature, PRD, provider/model integration, or product behavior change.

activation_examples: Hay dung agent implement de lam PRD sau
Tich hop provider/model moi vao Viezan

relationship_model: workflow -> rules/skills used by its steps
skill -> domain rubric/checklist and related workflow references
rule -> guardrail applied during planning, editing and verification
requirements: Resolve every capability path before planning or editing.
Read the primary workflow and relevant skill/rule definitions before implementation.
Use only capabilities declared here or referenced by the selected workflow unless the user asks to add a new capability.
If a required capability is missing or a reference is broken, report Capability Drift and fix the agent registry before coding.

conditional.when: Provider, model routing, default model or API integration changes
IPC, preload, API key, local server, external URL or sensitive data changes
UI text, locale, extension copy or public-facing text changes
chrome-extension/, browser bridge or extension UX changes
Live Translate, audio, streaming, subtitle, timers or listeners change
User-visible behavior, docs, prompts or release notes change

operating_workflow.action: Read the user request/PRD and identify affected source areas, user flows, persistence, IPC/provider/i18n/docs impact.
Use viezan-feature-planner for impact map, contracts, implementation plan, verification and risks.
Apply viezan-product-engineering and generate-code while editing code, tests, i18n and docs.
Run provider, security, i18n, extension, live-perf or docs capabilities only when the change touches those domains.
Run focused tests/build/typecheck and report commands, residual risks and changed files.

completion_rules: Do not implement from an ad hoc plan before resolving the primary workflow and mandatory capabilities.
Every touched domain must map to one declared conditional capability or be called out as Capability Drift.
Final verification must list the workflows/skills/rules actually used.
